estimates.assumptions: 2 lbs (907 g) raw salt beef (brisket), drained after soaking; plain meat has no carbohydrates
1 cup (200 g) dry yellow split peas before soaking and cooking; fully used in pease pudding; values based on standard USDA data for dry split peas
1 medium head cabbage (approx 900 g raw, edible portion only after trimming outer leaves); standard values for raw cabbage
6 medium carrots (approx 360 g raw, peeled); standard values for raw carrots
1 large turnip (rutabaga, approx 400 g raw, peeled); standard values for raw rutabaga
8 medium potatoes (approx 1.2 kg raw, peeled); standard values for raw potatoes with skin removed
3 tbsp (42 g) butter, fully used in pease pudding; pure fat has no carbohydrates
Black pepper to taste; negligible contribution, cannot reasonably estimate without specific quantity
